description: Routing accuracy corpus — phrases that should/should not activate viz-2x2.
trigger_phrases: show me the trade-offs as a quadrant diagram
I want a quadrant diagram comparing four approaches
four modes of X — visualize them
visualize the relationships between these four things
comparison matrix for these four archetypes
draw a 2×2 with [axis A] on one side and [axis B] on the other
adversarial_phrases: show me a ranking of these options
make a flowchart of this decision
notes: Adversarial cases test wrong-cardinality (3 or 6, not 4), wrong-shape (ranking, flowchart, Venn), and gradient-vs-quadrant ambiguity. The trigger phrases mirror the WHAT+WHEN+NEG clause in skill.json description.
